---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a bounded, evidence-backed capability
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## User problem

Who needs this, and what concrete job is blocked today?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest visible change, its honest empty/failure states, and the one primary action.

## Trust boundary

Explain how outside content stays untrusted, who approves, which network origin or runner adapter is
needed (if any), and what must fail closed.

## Gates and evidence

Name the unit, runner, or browser gate that would prove the feature. State the strongest user-facing
claim that evidence would support.

## Lane

Identify the owner lane from `docs/codex-takeover/06_OPERATING_MODEL.md`.
